activity.notes: Mary became Queen of Scots six days after birth in 1542 and was forced to abdicate in 1567. The canonical name avoids confusion with Mary I of England.

sources.title: Mary, Queen of Scots (r.1542-1567) — The Royal Family
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family records Mary's Scottish reign as 1542-1567 and states that she was forced to abdicate in 1567.
